id, name, type, notify_webhook, notify_channel, notify_enabled, notify_in_app_enabled, notify_token, notify_last_at, notify_last_status, owner_id, created_at, updated_at
mapper.select: SELECT , m.role AS my_role, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM workspace_member m2 WHERE m2.workspace_id = w.id) AS member_count FROM workspace w JOIN workspace_member m ON m.workspace_id = w.id WHERE m.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY CASE WHEN w.type = 'personal' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, w.created_at, w.id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO workspace (id, name, type, notify_webhook, owner_id) VALUES (#{id}, #{name}, #{type}, #{notifyWebhook}, #{ownerId})
mapper.update: UPDATE workspace SET notify_last_at = NOW(), notify_last_status = #{status} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM workspace WHERE owner_id = #{ownerId} AND type = 'shared'
